reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Cleanser 150ml (+20ml)
reviews.text: I really love this cleanser! 🤍 It cleanses my skin very well without making it feel tight or dry. It’s gentle, refreshing, and leaves my skin feeling clean, soft, and comfortable. Definitely a great cleanser for everyday use!
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢款潔面乳！🤍 佢清潔得好乾淨，但又唔會令皮膚有繃緊或者乾燥嘅感覺。佢好溫和又清爽，洗完之後皮膚感覺乾淨、柔軟又舒服。絕對係一款好適合日日用嘅潔面乳！

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Cleanser 150ml (+20ml)
reviews.text: I absolutely love this cleansing gel! It feels very gentle on my skin but still cleanses really well. It removes excess oil without leaving my skin feeling dry or tight. After using it, my skin feels fresh, soft, and comfortable. The texture is pleasant, it foams nicely, and a little product goes a long way. I also appreciate that it doesn’t irritate my skin or cause any discomfort. A great everyday cleanser that I would definitely recommend! ♥️
reviews.zh: 我超鍾意呢款潔面gel！佢對皮膚好溫和，但同時清潔力都唔錯。可以去除多餘油脂，又唔會令皮膚覺得乾燥或者繃緊。用完之後皮膚感覺清爽、柔軟又舒服。質地好舒服，泡量豐富，而且好少少就已經夠用。佢亦唔會刺激皮膚或者引致任何不適，好滿意。一款好值得推薦嘅日常潔面！♥️

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Cleanser 150ml (+20ml)
reviews.text: I really love this cleanser, it makes my face cleasning so much easier. Gets rid of even the most stubborn waterproof make up without irritation and makes my skin hydrated.
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢款潔面乳，佢令我塊面容易清潔好多。就算係最難卸嘅防水妝都清得甩，又唔會刺激皮膚，仲令皮膚保持保濕。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Cleanser 150ml (+20ml)
reviews.text: I have been using this cleanser for years and since I had my hands on it, I never changed. It’s light on my skin and it feels clean every time I wash my face. Even a little of it goes a long way. The big tube can last me for a long time.
reviews.zh: 我已經用咗呢款潔面乳好多年，自從開始用之後就再都冇轉過。佢對皮膚嚟講好輕柔，每次洗面之後都覺得好乾淨。唔使落好多就已經夠用，大支裝可以用好耐。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Cleanser 150ml (+20ml)
reviews.text: My daughter has been using this for two years now; she's 19. She loves it. She has sensitive skin, and this gel doesn't strip her skin after cleansing. Overall, the entire line is great for young skin.
reviews.zh: 我個女而家已經用咗兩年，佢而家 19 歲。佢好鍾意。佢有敏感肌，但呢款gel洗完之後唔會令皮膚流失水分。整體嚟講，成條線都好適合年輕皮膚。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Cleanser 150ml (+20ml)
reviews.text:
透明のツヤツヤなジェルが毛穴をスッキリさせてくれました。
泡立ちも良く、メイクもしっかり落ちます！
クレンジングを出先で忘れてしまったことがありましたが、これ一本でしっかり落ちたので頼もしい洗顔です。

嫌な突っ張り感や、乾燥感などはなく、必要な潤いはちゃんも残してくれています。
reviews.zh:
透明又帶有光澤嘅gel將毛孔清得好乾淨。
泡量豐富，妝容都卸得好乾淨！
曾經出街唔記得帶卸妝產品，但靠呢一支就卸得乾淨，係一款好靠得住嘅潔面。

沖完之後冇討厭嘅繃緊感或者乾燥感，皮膚所需嘅水分都Keep得住。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Cleanser 150ml (+20ml)
reviews.text: Love the cleanser! This product makes my face feel clean and fresh. It is not harsh and doesn’t make my face feel dry. I could not find in Korea when I was there. Thankfully I can purchase online.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢款潔面乳！用完之後塊面感覺乾淨又清爽。佢唔會刺激皮膚，洗完之後塊面都唔會覺得乾。去韓國嗰陣搵唔到，好彩可以喺網上買到。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Cleanser 150ml (+20ml)
reviews.text: Second time purchase, It's a saviour for my sensitive skin, i do not have good experience with many cleansers especially when i pair up with an oil cleanser, but this one is so moisturising and soothing to sensitive skin. It pairs well my manyo and centella skin 1004 oil cleanser. Even if i use it alone, it cleanses effectively.
reviews.zh: 第二次回購，佢係我敏感肌嘅救星。之前用好多潔面乳都唔啱用，尤其係配搭卸妝油一齊用嘅時候更加唔得，但呢款對敏感肌嚟講好保濕又舒緩。佢同 manyo 同 centella skin 1004 卸妝油都好夾。就算單用，清洁力都好足夠。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
